auth.keepLead: Gcina konke okwenze njengo-{name}: engeza i-imeyili yakho nephasiwedi. Kuhlala kumahhala.
auth.signUpLead: Kumahhala. Amaresiphi akho, okokwakha namanothi kugcinwa kuyimfihlo ku-akhawunti yakho.
auth.trialNote: Usunayo i-akhawunti? Ukungena kuletha kuyo lokho okwenze njengo-{name}. Umusha lapha? <signup>Vula i-akhawunti</signup> ukuze ukugcine esikhundleni salokho.
auth.privacy: I-imeyili yakho nalokho okulondolozayo kusetshenziswa kuphela ukuqhuba i-akhawunti yakho, futhi kugcinwa ku-Amazon Web Services e-US. <privacy>Indlela i-Glazecalc ephatha ngayo imininingwane yakho</privacy>
auth.dataNotice: I-Glazecalc iyiphrojekthi yamahhala, enomthombo ovulekile, futhi ama-akhawunti agcinwa kumaseva ase-United States. Ungafunda imihlahlandlela futhi uzame isibali ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti, noma uqhube ikhophi yakho. Ukuthi uvule i-akhawunti lapha yini kuyisinqumo sakho, futhi iphrojekthi ayemukeli umthwalo ngakho. <where>Lapho i-akhawunti yakho igcinwa khona, nokukhetha kwakho</where>
auth.passkeyHint: I-passkey isebenzisa isigxivizo somunwe wakho, ubuso noma ukhiye wesikrini esikhundleni sephasiwedi. Yengeze ekhasini lakho le-akhawunti.

secondStep.heading: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili
secondStep.signingInAs: Iphasiwedi yakho ilungile. Isinyathelo esisodwa futhi ukuze ungene njengo-{email}.
secondStep.leadCode: Vula uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator bese ufaka ikhodi olubonisa yona ye-Glazecalc.
secondStep.leadPasskey: Sebenzisa i-passkey yakho ukuze uqede ukungena.
secondStep.leadRecovery: Faka elinye lamakhodi okubuyisela owalondoloza lapho uvula ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili. Ikhodi ngayinye isebenza kanye.
secondStep.codeHint: Izinombolo ezingu-{digits}. Ikhodi entsha ivela njalo ngemizuzwana engu-30.
secondStep.codeFormat: Faka ikhodi enezinombolo ezingu-{digits} evela ohlelweni lwakho lwe-authenticator.
secondStep.noPasskeysHere: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukusebenzisa ama-passkey. Sebenzisa enye indlela ngezansi, noma ungene kudivayisi engakwazi.
secondStep.useApp: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator esikhundleni salokho
secondStep.reloadNote: Lesi sinyathelo silinda imizuzu engu-{minutes}. Uma ushiya noma ulayisha kabusha leli khasi, kuzodingeka ufake iphasiwedi yakho futhi.
secondStep.expired: Ukungena kuthathe isikhathi eside kakhulu. Sicela ufake iphasiwedi yakho futhi.

passkey.cancelled: I-passkey ayisetshenziswanga: isicelo sikhanseliwe noma isikhathi siphelile, noma le divayisi ayinayo i-passkey ye-Glazecalc. Sicela uzame futhi, noma usebenzise enye indlela.
passkey.browserFailed: Lesi siphequluli asikwazanga ukusebenzisa i-passkey. Sicela uzame futhi, noma usebenzise enye indlela.

forgot.heading: Setha kabusha iphasiwedi yakho
forgot.checkInbox: Hlola i-inbox yakho nefolda ye-junk. Uma kungafiki lutho, hlola ikheli bese ucela futhi.
forgot.intro: Faka i-imeyili ye-akhawunti yakho, futhi sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokukhetha iphasiwedi entsha.
forgot.failed: Iphutha: i-imeyili yokusetha kabusha ayikwazanga ukuthunyelwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

reset.heading: Khetha iphasiwedi entsha
reset.incomplete: Leli khasi lidinga isixhumanisi esivela ku-imeyili yokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi, futhi lesi asiphelele.
reset.hint: Okungenani izinhlamvu ezingu-8. Yonke idivayisi engene ku-akhawunti izokhishwa.
reset.failed: Iphutha: iphasiwedi ayikwazanga ukushintshwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
reset.secondStep: Uma i-akhawunti yakho isebenzisa ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili, usazodinga uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator, i-passkey noma ikhodi yokubuyisela ukuze ungene.

account.keepText: Lokhu kuzama nakho konke okukukho kuyasuswa ngomhla {date}. Vula i-akhawunti yamahhala ukuze ukugcine: amaresiphi akho, okokwakha namanothi kuhlala kunjalo, futhi u-{name} uhlala eyigama lakho elibonakalayo.
account.title: I-akhawunti yakho
account.passwordHint: Okungenani izinhlamvu ezingu-8. Amanye amadivayisi angene kule akhawunti azokhishwa.
account.changeFailed: Iphutha: iphasiwedi ayikwazanga ukushintshwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
account.deleteText: Lokhu kususa i-akhawunti yakho nakho konke okulondolozile: amaresiphi, okokwakha, izithasiselo, amanothi, amarekhodi okushisa neseluleko. Akunakuhlehliswa.
account.deleteFailed: Iphutha: i-akhawunti ayikwazanga ukususwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
account.unverifiedText: Sathumela isixhumanisi ku-{email} lapho uvula le akhawunti. Sivule ukuze uqinisekise ukuthi ikheli ngelakho. Kuze kube yilapho sithumela ama-imeyili kulo kuphela uma ucela, njengokusetha kabusha iphasiwedi.
account.resendFailed: Iphutha: isixhumanisi asikwazanga ukuthunyelwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
account.emailText: Sithumela isixhumanisi ekhelini elisha, futhi i-imeyili yakho iyashintsha uma usivula. Siyalitshela nekheli lakho lamanje. Yonke idivayisi engene kule akhawunti izokhishwa.
account.emailFailed: Iphutha: isixhumanisi asikwazanga ukuthunyelwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
account.signOutText: Ikukhipha kuyo yonke idivayisi, nale ihlanganisiwe, futhi imise ama-access token akho nezixhumanisi zakho zokwabelana. Yisebenzise uma ulahlekelwe idivayisi noma ucabanga ukuthi omunye umuntu unemininingwane yakho yokungena.
account.signOutFailed: Iphutha: akukwazekanga ukuphuma. Sicela uzame futhi.
account.confirmStep: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kuvuliwe, ngakho qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe: iphasiwedi yakho nesinyathelo sesibili.

mfa.heading: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili
mfa.intro: Cela isinyathelo sesibili uma ungena, kanye nephasiwedi yakho: ikhodi evela ohlelweni lwe-authenticator, noma i-passkey. Bese umuntu othola iphasiwedi yakho angakwazi ukungena.
mfa.loadFailed: Ukungena kwakho ngezinyathelo ezimbili akukwazanga ukulayishwa. Sicela ulayishe kabusha ikhasi.
mfa.onText: Ungena ngephasiwedi yakho nesinyathelo sesibili, noma nge-passkey yodwa.
mfa.offText: Ukuze ukuvule, setha uhlelo lwe-authenticator noma wengeze i-passkey.
mfa.confirmEmailFirst: Qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho kuqala, ngenhla. Siyisebenzisa ukukutshela ngezinguquko endleleni ongena ngayo, nokusiza uma ulahlekelwa yisinyathelo sakho sesibili.
mfa.appText: Uhlelo olusefonini yakho noma kumphathi wakho wamaphasiwedi lubonisa ikhodi entsha njalo ngemizuzwana engu-30, ozoyifaka uma ungena.
mfa.passkeysText: I-passkey ikungenisa ngesigxivizo somunwe wakho, ubuso noma ukhiye wesikrini, kule divayisi noma efonini yakho. Ingaba yisinyathelo sakho sesibili, noma ikungenise yodwa, ngaphandle kwephasiwedi yakho.
mfa.noPasskeysHere: Lesi siphequluli asikwazi ukwenza noma ukusebenzisa ama-passkey. Zama esinye isiphequluli noma idivayisi.
mfa.name: Igama le-passkey
mfa.nameHint: Ukuze ukwazi ukuhlukanisa ama-passkey akho, njengo-"Laptop" noma "Ifoni".
mfa.nameCheck: Nika i-passkey igama elinezinhlamvu ezingu-1 kuya ku-{most}.
mfa.passkeyLimit: Unama-passkey angu-{most}, okuyinani elikhulu kakhulu i-akhawunti engaba nalo. Khipha eyodwa ukuze wengeze enye.
mfa.codesLeft: {count, plural, one {Kusele amakhodi okubuyisela angu-# kwangu-{total}.} other {Kusele amakhodi okubuyisela angu-# kwangu-{total}.}} Uma ungakwazi ukusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho noma i-passkey, ikhodi ikungenisa esikhundleni salokho. Ikhodi ngayinye isebenza kanye.
mfa.codesLow: Yenza amakhodi amasha maduze. Uma ephela futhi ulahlekelwa wuhlelo lwakho nama-passkey, ngeke ukwazi ukungena.
mfa.offWhat: Ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kuhlala kuvuliwe ngenkathi unohlelo lwe-authenticator noma i-passkey. Ukukhipha okokugcina kwakho kuyakuvala, bese:
mfa.offPassword: Ukungena kudinga iphasiwedi yakho kuphela, ngakho noma ubani oyithola angangena.
mfa.offSignOut: Yonke enye idivayisi engene ku-akhawunti yakho iyakhishwa. Le ihlala ingenile.
mfa.offPasskeys: {count, plural, =1 {Ukuze ukuvale, khipha i-passkey yakho ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla.} one {Ukuze ukuvale, khipha ama-passkey akho angu-# ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla.} other {Ukuze ukuvale, khipha ama-passkey akho angu-# ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla.}}
mfa.offPasskeysToo: {count, plural, =1 {Unayo futhi i-passkey: yikhiphe ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla, kanye nohlelo.} one {Unawo futhi ama-passkey angu-#: wakhiphe ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla, kanye nohlelo.} other {Unawo futhi ama-passkey angu-#: wakhiphe ngaphansi kokuthi Ama-passkey, ngenhla, kanye nohlelo.}}
mfa.addAppText: Ukuze usethe uhlelo lwe-authenticator, qala uqinisekise ukuthi nguwe.
mfa.removeAppText: Ukuze ukhiphe uhlelo lwe-authenticator, qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
mfa.addPasskeyText: Qamba i-passkey bese uqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe. Bese isiphequluli sakho sikucela ukuthi wenze i-passkey.
mfa.removePasskeyText: Ukuze ukhiphe i-passkey ethi "{name}", qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
mfa.newCodesText: Amakhodi amasha athatha indawo yawo amadala, ayeka ukusebenza. Qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
mfa.lastFactor: Lesi yisinyathelo sakho sesibili sokugcina, ngakho ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kuyavaleka futhi amakhodi akho okubuyisela ayayeka ukusebenza.
mfa.passkeyNext: Isiphequluli sakho sicela i-passkey yakho uma uqhubeka.
mfa.passkeyReadyText: Siyabonga. Manje yenza i-passkey ethi "{name}": uma ucindezela inkinobho, isiphequluli sakho sicela isigxivizo somunwe wakho, ubuso noma ukhiye wesikrini, noma ifoni yakho. Uma kungasebenzi, ungazama futhi imizuzu engu-{minutes} ngaphandle kokuqinisekisa futhi.
mfa.useApp: Sebenzisa uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator esikhundleni salokho
mfa.failed: Iphutha: ushintsho alukwazanga ukwenziwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
mfa.setupOpen: Vula uhlelo lwakho lwe-authenticator bese ukhetha ukwengeza i-akhawunti.
mfa.setupScan: Skena le khodi ye-QR ngohlelo, noma uthayiphe ukhiye.
mfa.setupTap: Thepha inkinobho ukuze wengeze i-Glazecalc ohlelweni lwe-authenticator noma kumphathi wamaphasiwedi kule foni.
mfa.showQr: Bonisa ikhodi ye-QR, ukuze uyisethe kwenye idivayisi
mfa.qrAlt: Ikhodi ye-QR yokwengeza i-Glazecalc ohlelweni lwe-authenticator
mfa.clipboardNote: Umbhalo okhophelwe ungahlala emlandweni webhodi lakho lokunamathisela futhi ufike kwamanye amadivayisi akho. Wunamathisele ngqo kumphathi wakho wamaphasiwedi, bese usula umlando webhodi lokunamathisela.
mfa.setupCode: Faka ikhodi enezinombolo ezingu-{digits} uhlelo olubonisa yona manje ye-Glazecalc
mfa.codesText: Wagcine endaweni ephephile, njengakumphathi wakho wamaphasiwedi, noma uwaphrinte bese uwagcina namaphepha akho. Uma ungakwazi ukusebenzisa uhlelo lwakho noma i-passkey, ikhodi ikungenisa esikhundleni salokho. Ikhodi ngayinye isebenza kanye. Aboniswa manje kuphela.
mfa.printNote: Ikhodi ngayinye isebenza kanye. Gcina leli khasi endaweni ephephile.
mfa.copyFailed: Akukwazekanga ukukhophela. Sicela ukhethe umbhalo bese uwukhophela.
mfa.fileNote: Ikhodi ngayinye isebenza kanye. Gcina leli fayela endaweni ephephile.

export.heading: Landa imininingwane yami
export.text: Londoloza ikhophi yakho konke okuphethwe yi-akhawunti yakho njengefayela elilodwa: imininingwane yakho, izilungiselelo, okokwakha onakho, amaresiphi, okokwakha, izithasiselo, amanothi, amarekhodi okushisa, iseluleko nodoti. Ayifaki iphasiwedi yakho. Gcina ifayela endaweni eyimfihlo, ngoba liphethe konke okulondolozile.
export.csvText: Noma londoloza i-spreadsheet yamaresiphi akho kuphela noma yokokwakha kwakho kuphela, ukuze uyivule ku-Excel, Numbers noma Sheets.

trash.heading: Udoti
trash.text: Lokho okukhipha encwadini yakho kulinda kuDoti izinsuku ezingu-30. Kubuyise kusuka lapho, noma ukusule unomphela.

shared.heading: Amaresiphi abelwana ngawo
shared.text: Amaresiphi owabelana ngawo ngesixhumanisi, noma ubani onesixhumanisi angawafunda ngaphandle kwe-akhawunti. Isixhumanisi siboniswa kanye kuphela, uma senziwa, ngakho asikwazi ukuboniswa lapha. Ukuze wabelane futhi ngeresiphi, yenza isixhumanisi esisha ngaphansi kokuthi Okunye kweresiphi.
shared.stopped: U-{name} akusabelwana ngaye. Isixhumanisi sayo asisasebenzi.
shared.fetchFailed: Amaresiphi akho abelwana ngawo awakwazanga ukulayishwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

settings.heading: Izilungiselelo
settings.intro: Zilondolozwe ne-akhawunti yakho, ngakho zisebenza kuyo yonke idivayisi.
settings.saveFailed: Isilungiselelo asikwazanga ukulondolozwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

language.help: Ulimi lohlelo, lwemihlahlandlela nolwama-imeyili akho. Ukulushintsha kuvula leli khasi ngalolo limi.

none.label: Akukhethwanga
none.saved: Kulondoloziwe: asikho isifunda esikhethiwe; okuzenzakalelayo kulandela isiphequluli sakho.

region.help: Okokwakha okuthengiswa lapho, nokuzenzakalelayo kwezinombolo, izinsuku, amazinga okushisa nama-cone ngezansi. Uze ukhethe, kulandela ulimi lwesiphequluli sakho.

auto.label: Njengolimi lwami nesifunda sami
auto.saved: Kulondoloziwe: izinombolo nezinsuku njengoba ulimi lwakho nesifunda sakho kuzibhala.

format.help: Indlela izinombolo nezinsuku ezibhalwa ngayo: 12,345.6 noma 12.345,6, nokulandelana kosuku nenyanga.

calendar.help: Ikhalenda izinsuku eziboniswa ngalo. Izinsuku ozithayiphayo zihlala ekhalendeni lama-Gregorian.

buddhist.label: Inkathi yamaBuddha yaseThailand
buddhist.saved: Kulondoloziwe: izinsuku ziboniswa ngenkathi yamaBuddha yaseThailand.

digits.help: Izinombolo ezisetshenziswa ukubonisa amanani. Ezinye izilimi zinezazo, njengesi-Arabhu, isi-Bengali nesi-Hindi, futhi lapho ukhona kunquma ukuthi yiziphi ezijwayelekile. Ungathayipha izinombolo ngazo zombili.

native.label: Izinombolo zolimi uqobo, lapho lunazo
native.saved: Kulondoloziwe: amanani aboniswa ngezinombolo zolimi uqobo, lapho lunazo.

either.label: Ukhefana noma ichashazi lamadesimali
either.saved: Kulondoloziwe: amanani angathayiphwa ngokhefana noma ngechashazi.

decimalMark.help: Ngakho kokubili, inani elifana no-1,250 lifundwa ngendlela izinombolo zakho ezibhalwa ngayo ngenhla.

temperature.help: Uze ukhethe, lokhu kulandela isifunda sakho: °F e-United States, °C kwezinye izindawo.

cones.help: Uze ukhethe, lokhu kulandela isifunda sakho: ama-cone e-Orton e-US, e-UK, e-Ireland, e-Australia nase-New Zealand, ama-cone e-SK e-Japan, izinga lokushisa kulo lonke elinye iYurophu.

density.help: Indlela imihlahlandlela enikeza ngayo ukujiya kwe-glaze. Uze ukhethe, lokhu kulandela isifunda sakho: ama-degree e-Baumé e-Italy nase-Japan, i-specific gravity kwezinye izindawo.

currency.help: Amanani owanikeza okokwakha, nalokho i-batch ekubizayo, kusemalini le. Ukuyishintsha akuguquli amanani osuwanikezile. Uze ukhethe, lokhu kulandela isifunda sakho.
currency.notConverted: Amanani akho agciniwe awaguqulwanga: asewuzinombolo owazinikeza.

system.label: Njengoba le divayisi isethiwe
system.saved: Kulondoloziwe: ukukhanya noma ubumnyama njengoba idivayisi ngayinye isethiwe.

theme.help: Amaresiphi aphrintiwe ahlala emnyama phezu kokumhlophe.

palette.help: Ezinkinobho, ezixhumanisini nakumathebhu, aqanjwe ngama-glaze. Ngalinye kulula ukulifunda ekukhanyeni nasebumnyameni.

single.label: Kuze kube yingxenye yeshumi yegremu
single.saved: Kulondoloziwe: amagremu aboniswa kuze kube yingxenye yeshumi.

full.label: Ukunemba okugcwele
full.saved: Kulondoloziwe: amagremu aboniswa ngokugcwele, kuze kube yizindawo zamadesimali ezingu-5.

gramPrecision.help: Kuze kube yingxenye yeshumi, amanani angaphansi kuka-10 g asabonisa izingxenye zekhulu (2.35 g), okokufaka umbala kuma-batch amancane okuhlola.

off.label: Kuvaliwe: ungalokothi wengeze umthofu (Pb) eresiphini noma uwuphakamise
off.saved: Kulondoloziwe: umthofu (Pb) awulokothi wengezwe eresiphini noma uphakanyiswe.

on.label: Kuvuliwe: okokwakha okunomthofu (Pb) kungengezwa futhi kuphakanyiswe
on.saved: Kulondoloziwe: okokwakha okunomthofu (Pb) kungengezwa futhi kuphakanyiswe.

lead.help: Umthofu (lead, Pb) uwushevu uma uwuhogela noma uwugwinya futhi uyanqwabelana emzimbeni, futhi i-glaze enomthofu ingawukhiphela ekudleni nasekuphuzweni; akukho kubala okungasho ukuthi isitsha esishisiwe siyakwenza yini. Uma kuvaliwe, amaresiphi asevele enomthofu asavuleka njengoba ayenjalo.
lead.warning: Sebenzisa umthofu (Pb) kuphela njenge-frit, ungalokothi njengomthofu obomvu, omhlophe noma ophuzi ongahlanganisiwe noma i-litharge. Wuxube umanzi, ungalokothi uwufafaze, gqoka i-respirator futhi uhlanze ngamanzi. Gcina izitsha ezine-glaze enomthofu (Pb) kude nokudla neziphuzo ngaphandle uma ukuhlolwa kokuphuma kwezinsimbi (leach test) kwelabhorethri kwesitsha esishisiwe kuphumelele.

on.saved: Kulondoloziwe: isiNgisi siboniswa ngemva kwamagama abalulekile.

confirmEmail.failed: Iphutha: ikheli alikwazanga ukuqinisekiswa. Sicela uzame futhi.

providers.heading: I-Google, i-GitHub ne-Microsoft
providers.intro: Xhumanisa i-akhawunti ye-Google, ye-GitHub noma ye-Microsoft ukuze ungene ngayo. I-Glazecalc igcina kuphela i-id ye-akhawunti evela kuyo, hhayi igama layo, isithombe noma okunye, futhi ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili kusacela isinyathelo sako sesibili.
providers.passwordless: Le akhawunti ayinayo iphasiwedi. Ukuze ushintshe i-imeyili yakho, ukungena ngezinyathelo ezimbili noma izindlela ongena ngazo, noma ukuze usule i-akhawunti yakho, uqinisekisa ukuthi nguwe ngokungena futhi nge-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft, noma yikuphi okuxhumanisile. Ungasetha futhi iphasiwedi.
providers.setPasswordUnlinks: Ukusetha iphasiwedi ngesixhumanisi esithunyelwe nge-imeyili kuyaqeda nokuxhumanisa i-Google, i-GitHub ne-Microsoft. Ungaziphinda uzixhumanise ngemva kwalokho.
providers.setPasswordFailed: Isixhumanisi asikwazanga ukuthunyelwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
providers.confirmFirst: Qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho kuqala, ngesixhumanisi esikuthumelele sona, ukuze uxhumanise i-Google, i-GitHub noma i-Microsoft.
providers.reauthIntro: Le akhawunti ayinayo iphasiwedi, ngakho qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe ngokungena futhi. Bese wenza ushintsho kungakapheli imizuzu engu-5.
providers.reauthHeld: Ungene futhi nge-{provider}. Ungenza ushintsho olulodwa ngaphandle kwephasiwedi emizuzwini engu-5 elandelayo.
providers.reauthFirst: Sicela ungene futhi kuqala, ngenye yezinkinobho ezingenhla.
providers.reauthFailed: Akukwazekanga ukuqala ukungena futhi. Sicela uzame futhi.

apps.title: Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe
apps.lead: Abasizi, izikripthi nezinhlelo ezingafinyelela amarekhodi akho. Bona ukuthi ngakunye kwenzeni, buyisa lokho okukuyise kuDoti, futhi ukumise noma nini uthanda.

confirm.heading: Qinisekisa ngaphambi kwezinguquko
confirm.intro: Khetha ukuthi ushintsho oluvela kumsizi, ohlelweni noma ku-access token lulinde yini uze uluvume lapha, ungenile. Akukho olukucelayo okushintshwayo uze ukwenze.
confirm.offHint: Izinguquko zenziwa ngaso leso sikhathi. Ngalunye lugcina irekhodi njengoba lalinjalo, ukuze ukwazi ukuluhlehlisa, futhi lokho uhlelo ngalunye olukwenzile kuboniswa ngezansi.
confirm.removalsHintSite: Ukuyisa irekhodi kuDoti, ukukhipha okokwakha kokokwakha onakho, noma ukukhipha irekhodi lokushisa eresiphini kulinda imvume yakho kule webhusayithi.
confirm.allHint: Lonke irekhodi elisha, ushintsho, ukuhlehlisa nokukhipha kulinda imvume yakho kule webhusayithi.
confirm.how: Ushintsho olulindayo lunekhasi lalo, umsizi noma isikripthi esikunika isixhumanisi salo. Lulinda imizuzu engu-30, bese kungashintshwa lutho. I-access token eyenziwe nokuthi "Izinguquko ezivela kule token azidingi ukuqinisekiswa" ayilokothi ibuzwe.
confirm.saveFailed: Iphutha: ukukhetha kwakho akukwazanga ukulondolozwa. Sicela uzame futhi.

connect.appOnDevice: Uhlelo kudivayisi yakho oluvula izixhumanisi ze-{scheme}

connect.loopbackWriteWarning: Luphinde lucele ukushintsha amarekhodi akho: noma yiluphi uhlelo kule khompyutha oluthola impendulo lungabe seluwashintsha.

tokens.heading: Ama-access token
tokens.intro: I-access token ivumela umsizi wakho we-AI noma isikripthi sakho ukuthi sifunde amaresiphi, okokwakha, amanothi namarekhodi okushisa ku-akhawunti yakho, futhi, uma ukhetha, sikushintshe. I-token ngayinye iyeka ukusebenza ngosuku olukhethayo, noma ngokushesha nje uma uyihoxisa.
tokens.seeThem: Ama-token akho nezinhlelo ezixhunyiwe, lokho ngakunye okwenzile, nokuthi Hoxisa kusekhasini elithi Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe.
tokens.revokeFailed: Iphutha: i-token ayikwazanga ukuhoxiswa. Sicela uzame futhi.
tokens.loadFailed: Ama-access token akho awakwazanga ukulayishwa. Sicela ulayishe kabusha ikhasi ukuze uzame futhi.
tokens.name: Igama
tokens.nameHint: Okuthile ongayihlukanisa ngakho, njengomsizi noma ikhompyutha eyenzelwe yona.
tokens.nameCheck: Sicela unike i-token igama elinezinhlamvu ezingu-1 kuya ku-{most}.
tokens.expiryHint: Sikuthumelela i-imeyili izinsuku ezingu-7 ngaphambi kokuba i-token iyeke ukusebenza.
tokens.expiryWriteHint: {count, plural, one {I-token engashintsha amarekhodi akho iyeka ukusebenza ngemva kwezinsuku ezingeqile ku-#.} other {I-token engashintsha amarekhodi akho iyeka ukusebenza ngemva kwezinsuku ezingeqile ku-#.}}
tokens.confirmEmailFirst: Ngaphambi kokuthi ukwazi ukwenza i-token, qinisekisa i-imeyili yakho: vula isixhumanisi esisithumele ku-{email}. Sikutshela kulelo kheli uma kwenziwa i-token nangaphambi kokuthi iyeke ukusebenza.
tokens.scopeNote: I-token ingafunda amarekhodi akho kodwa ingawashintshi.
tokens.scopeWriteNote: I-token ingaphinda ilondoloze amarekhodi amasha, iwashintshe futhi iwayise kuDoti. Ushintsho ngalunye lugcina irekhodi njengoba lalinjalo, ukuze ukwazi ukuluhlehlisa, futhi lokho i-token ekwenzile kusekhasini elithi Izinhlelo ezixhunyiwe nakokuthi Landa imininingwane yami. Khetha lokhu kuphela kumsizi noma isikripthi osithemba ukuthi singashintsha amarekhodi akho.
tokens.confirmStep: Ukuze wenze i-token, qinisekisa ukuthi nguwe.
tokens.failed: Iphutha: i-token ayikwazanga ukwenziwa. Sicela uzame futhi.
tokens.limit: Unama-access token angu-{most} asebenzayo, okuyinani elikhulu kakhulu i-akhawunti engaba nalo. Hoxisa eyodwa ukuze wenze enye.
tokens.newText: Lesi yisikhathi kuphela eboniswa ngaso. Noma ubani onayo angafunda amarekhodi akho ize iyeke ukusebenza, ngakho yigcine njengephasiwedi, futhi uyinike kuphela umsizi wakho noma isikripthi sakho.
tokens.newTextWrite: Lesi yisikhathi kuphela eboniswa ngaso. Noma ubani onayo angafunda futhi ashintshe amarekhodi akho ize iyeke ukusebenza, ngakho yigcine njengephasiwedi, futhi uyinike kuphela umsizi wakho noma isikripthi sakho.
tokens.copyFailed: Akukwazekanga ukukhophela. Khetha i-token bese uyikhophela wena.
